name: Seats
description: Named seats on the row, each holding the subjects seated in it. A caller takes a seat for itself, or seats and unseats another, and leaves a seat it holds without a permission. A seat may cap how many it holds (max), and a take of a full seat is refused, or unseats the subject seated longest (onFull). A seat may seat the subject an own field holds (fromField), who counts in it and cannot leave it while the field holds them. A Workflow transition's by and a StateRules state's by name a seat as seat:<name>, which a caller seated in it passes. The behaviors' core alone implements it, on a table; no engine type composes it.

assign.description: The permission a caller needs to seat or unseat another subject; no caller may when absent. A caller leaves a seat it holds without it.

fromField.description: An own field that holds a subject (string, Identity.UUID or Identity.UserID): the subject it holds is seated, counts toward max, is never displaced, and cannot leave the seat while the field holds them.

max.description: How many subjects the seat holds at most, the subject its fromField holds among them; no cap when absent.

onFull.description: What a take of a full seat does: refuse, the veto seat_full, or displace, which unseats the subject seated longest that the seat's fromField does not hold; refuse when absent. Needs max.

take.description: The permission a caller needs to seat itself; any caller may when absent.

tables.name: occupants
tables.description: One row per subject seated on the row, keyed by its number, the order they were seated in: the seat, the subject, and when and by whom it was seated. A leave or a displacement deletes its row; the subject a seat's fromField holds needs none.

fields.name: number
fields.description: The occupant's number on the row, one past the greatest when it was seated, in ten digits zero-padded so the key's order is theirs.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: The subject seated, a hyphenated UUID kept in base62.

fields.name: seatedAt
fields.description: When it was seated, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: seatedBy
fields.description: The subject of the caller who seated it: the subject itself, or the one who assigned it.

operations.name: takeSeat
operations.description: Seats a subject in a seat: the caller, with the seat's take permission when it names one, or another, with its assign permission. A full seat refuses it, or unseats the subject seated longest when its onFull is displace. A subject seated already is answered unchanged.

subject.description: The subject to seat; the caller's own when absent. Seating another needs the seat's assign permission.

displaced.description: The subjects the take unseated to make room, longest seated first; [] for none.

subject.description: The subject seated, a hyphenated UUID in base62.

unchanged.description: True when the subject was seated already, so nothing was written; absent otherwise.

operations.name: leaveSeat
operations.description: Unseats a subject from a seat: the caller, which needs no permission, or another, with the seat's assign permission. The subject the seat's fromField holds cannot leave while it holds them. A subject not seated is answered unchanged.

subject.description: The subject to unseat; the caller's own when absent. Unseating another needs the seat's assign permission.
The subject unseated, a hyphenated UUID in base62.

unchanged.description: True when the subject was not seated, so nothing was written; absent otherwise.

operations.name: listSeats
operations.description: Lists the subjects seated on the row, by seat in code point order, each seat's fromField subject first and then the others in the order they were seated; with seat, only its subjects.

fromField.description: Whether the seat's fromField holds the subject.

seatedAt.description: When it was seated, in epoch milliseconds; null for the subject the seat's fromField holds with no row of its own.

seatedBy.description: The subject of the caller who seated it; null as seatedAt is.

vetoes.description: takeSeat of a seat that holds its max, whose onFull is refuse or whose every occupant its fromField holds, or an update that gives the fromField of a seat whose onFull is refuse a subject not seated there, past its max; details give the seat, its max and the subjects seated.
leaveSeat of the subject the seat's fromField holds, who leaves only when the field holds another; details give the seat, the subject and the field.
